#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import json
import time
import datetime
import feedparser
import requests

# 配置
RSS_FEEDS = [
    "https://news.ycombinator.com/rss",
    "https://hnrss.org/newest",
    "https://www.reddit.com/r/python/.rss"
]
OUTPUT_DIR = "data/output"
MAX_ITEMS = 3

def fetch_and_digest():
    if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_DIR):
        os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR)
    
    all_entries = []
    for url in RSS_FEEDS:
        try:
            feed = feedparser.parse(url)
            for entry in feed.entries[:MAX_ITEMS]:
                all_entries.append({
                    "title": entry.get("title", "No Title"),
                    "link": entry.get("link", ""),
                    "summary": entry.get("summary", "No summary available"),
                    "source": url,
                    "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
                })
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching {url}: {e}")

    if not all_entries:
        print("No entries found.")
        return

    # 模拟摘要生成过程 (ACT阶段验证逻辑)
    for entry in all_entries:
        entry["digest"] = f"Brief: {entry['title'][:50]}..."

    filename = f"digest_{int(time.time())}.json"
    filepath = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename)
    
    with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(all_entries, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    
    print(f"Successfully wrote {len(all_entries)} entries to {filepath}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 确保依赖已安装（在实际生产环境中应由环境管理，此处为脚本健壮性）
    try:
        import feedparser
    except ImportError:
        import subprocess
        subprocess.check_call(["pip3", "install", "feedparser"])
        import feedparser
        
    fetch_and_digest()
